text:
alex: Morning — quick rollout pulse. Plan: canary at 10:30 PDT. Need status on backports for the 1.12 UI fix and any blockers.

maria: Backport PRs open: #2418 (UI fix) and #2421 (session timeout). #2418 has a conflict in `pkg/ui/header.go` — resolving now, ETA ~2h. CC @kevin for the flaky tests.

kevin: Got it. I'm hitting flakes in `storage_test.go::TestCompact` locally, looks like a race introduced by commit `9f2a3b4`. Spinning up a revert branch `revert/9f2a3b4` to isolate.

sophia: Night shift here — I can hold the canary after 10:30 if you want manual oversight. Any manual runbook steps? @alex

alex: Thanks. Manual steps: run `./scripts/prepare_canary.sh`, then bump `imageTag` to `prod-canary-17685`. Quick snippet: 

```
kubectl set image deploy/front-end front=redwood/front:prod-canary-17685
./scripts/monitor_canary.sh
```

maria: Heads-up: DB migration backport created as #2425 referencing migration `2026_03_add_index`. Might need a migration lock; coordinating with infra.

jamie: If backports land before 10:00 we can include them in the canary. Otherwise we'll cut a second canary tomorrow. Also note PR #2409 added a dependency that bumps image size ~60MB — could affect start times.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `prod-canary-17685` at 1768502520. Health checks passing 2/3.

kevin: Update: reproduced flaky test in CI, pushed fix to branch `fix/ci-race-2422`, running tests now. If green I'll open backport PR for the release branch.

sophia: I can watch the deploy from 10:25–11:30. Ping me on this thread when you hit the monitor step.

alex: Solid. If anything blocks the canary we'll roll to fallback `prod-stable` and run the rollback playbook. :thumbsup:
